sources.title: avlp12 (ALISVOLATPROPRIIS) - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: One base model, four packagings: MLX dynamic 2.6 bpw (text/VLM) and the Ultra GGUF variants. Same base model and 3.6 bpw quantization — text-only primary plus the vision add-on. One base model (GLM-5.2 744B MoE), four MLX quant builds from 512 GB-class to the 256 GB floor — plus the GLM-5.1 benchmark baseline.

sources.title: GLM-5.3 & GLM-5.2 & GLM-5.1 & GLM-5 - GitHub
sources.snippet: GLM-5.3 uses the same base model as GLM-5.2 — every gain comes from post-training. Compared with GLM-5.2, it is much better at complex coding and long-horizon tasks: Stronger Coding: GLM-5.3 is the most capable open-weights model for coding, with a 50% improvement over GLM-5.2 on our in-house Z.ai ...

sources.title: glm53-flash-mlx/README.md at main - GitHub
sources.snippet: glm53-flash-mlx MLX (Apple Silicon) runtime and quantization tooling for zai-org/GLM-5.3-Flash — 320B-A18B: 34 Kimi-Delta linear-attention layers interleaved with 11 DeepSeek-sparse-attention layers (NoPE MLA behind a lightning indexer), 288-expert MoE, manifold-constrained hyper-connections (model_type: glm5_next).
